exposure: Maternal accommodation during neonatal unit admission
cohort: 196 mothers of neonates admitted to the neonatal unit at Steve Biko Academic Hospital in Pretoria, South Africa, between March 11 and December 30, 2017.
finding: Mothers' accommodation during their babies' admission to the neonatal unit, having poor interpersonal relationships, and experiencing intimate partner violence (IPV) were significantly associated with screening positive for postnatal depression.
